questions.body_en: Andy bought a 4-metre rope. He used 250 cm of it and cut the rest into 5 equal pieces. How long is each piece?

questions.body_id: Berapa banyak bilangan dari 1 sampai 100 yang merupakan kelipatan 4 dan 5 sekaligus?

questions.body_en: Twelve trees are planted at equal distance from each other along a straight path. The distance between the 1st and 5th tree is 30 metres. What is the distance between the 3rd and 5th tree?
questions.body_id: Dua belas pohon ditanam dengan jarak yang sama satu sama lain di sepanjang jalan lurus. Jarak antara pohon ke-1 dan ke-5 adalah 30 meter. Berapa jarak antara pohon ke-3 dan ke-5?

questions.body_en: Jeremy had $10 in his piggy bank on January 1, 2019 which is a Tuesday. He put $2 into the piggy bank every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. On which date would he reach $30 in his piggy bank?
questions.body_id: Jeremy memiliki $10 di celengannya pada tanggal 1 Januari 2019 yang jatuh pada hari Selasa. Ia memasukkan $2 ke celengan setiap hari Senin, Rabu, dan Sabtu. Pada tanggal berapa uang di celengannya mencapai $30?

questions.body_en: How many different 2-digit numbers have only odd digits?

questions.body_en: Jocelyn, Hector, Thomas and Christie are siblings. Hector is not the youngest. Thomas is older than Jocelyn, and Hector is younger than Christie. Who is the youngest among the siblings?
questions.body_id: Jocelyn, Hector, Thomas, dan Christie bersaudara. Hector bukan yang termuda. Thomas lebih tua daripada Jocelyn, dan Hector lebih muda daripada Christie. Siapakah yang termuda di antara saudara-saudara itu?

questions.body_en: Use all the digits 2, 0, 1 and 9 to form a number closest to 1969.

questions.body_en: It is given that a square + a triangle + a circle + a circle = 32, and a square = a triangle + 20. What number does the sum square + circle + circle stand for?
questions.body_id: Diketahui bahwa persegi + segitiga + lingkaran + lingkaran = 32, dan persegi = segitiga + 20. Berapakah nilai dari jumlah persegi + lingkaran + lingkaran?

questions.body_en: Tom will be twice his age in 4 years from now. Three years ago, the sum of Tom's and Jerry's ages was 10. In how many years from now will Jerry's age be doubled?
questions.body_id: Tom akan berusia dua kali lipat dari usianya sekarang dalam 4 tahun ke depan. Tiga tahun yang lalu, jumlah usia Tom dan Jerry adalah 10. Dalam berapa tahun dari sekarang usia Jerry akan menjadi dua kali lipat?

questions.body_en: The picture graph below shows the number of stamps 5 children have at first. Each triangle stands for 3 stamps. Anthony has 1 triangle, Brandon has 2 triangles, Carol has 4 triangles, Dennis has 3 triangles and Elizabeth has 4 triangles. Carol distributes all her stamps equally among Anthony, Brandon, Dennis and Elizabeth. How many more stamps does Elizabeth have than Anthony now?
questions.body_id: Diagram gambar di bawah ini menunjukkan banyaknya prangko yang dimiliki 5 anak pada awalnya. Setiap segitiga mewakili 3 prangko. Anthony memiliki 1 segitiga, Brandon memiliki 2 segitiga, Carol memiliki 4 segitiga, Dennis memiliki 3 segitiga, dan Elizabeth memiliki 4 segitiga. Carol membagikan semua prangkonya secara merata kepada Anthony, Brandon, Dennis, dan Elizabeth. Berapa lebih banyak prangko yang dimiliki Elizabeth dibandingkan Anthony sekarang?

questions.body_en: A mother baked 235 cookies for her children, Grace, Scott and Cindy. Cindy received 15 more cookies than Scott. Grace received 8 less cookies than Scott. How many cookies did Grace receive?
questions.body_id: Seorang ibu memanggang 235 kue untuk anak-anaknya, yaitu Grace, Scott, dan Cindy. Cindy menerima 15 kue lebih banyak daripada Scott. Grace menerima 8 kue lebih sedikit daripada Scott. Berapa banyak kue yang diterima Grace?

questions.body_en: Claire had 0 cupcakes while Alice and Bob had some. Alice gave half of her cupcakes to Claire. Bob gave 17 cupcakes to Claire. Claire has 55 cupcakes now. How many cupcakes did Alice have in the beginning?
questions.body_id: Claire mula-mula memiliki 0 kue mangkuk, sedangkan Alice dan Bob memiliki beberapa. Alice memberikan separuh kue mangkuknya kepada Claire. Bob memberikan 17 kue mangkuk kepada Claire. Sekarang Claire memiliki 55 kue mangkuk. Berapa banyak kue mangkuk yang dimiliki Alice pada awalnya?

questions.body_en: Picture 2 shows the completed version of the puzzle in Picture 1. Complete the puzzle in Picture 3 and find the missing number "?".

questions.body_en: In the following addition, all the different letters stand for different digits: ACB + ACB = BDDC. What is the value of the 4-digit number BDDC?
questions.body_id: Dalam penjumlahan berikut, setiap huruf yang berbeda mewakili angka yang berbeda: ACB + ACB = BDDC. Berapakah nilai bilangan empat angka BDDC?
